name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells with palms facing your thighs.
Soften your knees and hinge forward with a flat back until your arms hang below your shoulders.
Pull your elbows out wide to the sides until your upper arms align with your back.
Pause briefly squeezing your rear delts, then lower the dumbbells under control.
tips: Keep your torso at the same angle throughout the pull without bouncing upright.
Keep your shoulders down away from your ears and forearms roughly vertical at the top.
